verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents versioning, review, or rollback of Medusa workflows or automations. Git-based deploys and PR previews (medusa-docs-1, medusa-docs-11) cover general code deployment, relying on GitHub as the host platform. Automatic backups and audit logs are data-level features. None of these is a first-party automation version history, review, or rollback capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
